result: I ported both scripts to Godot 4 syntax (nothing could be run here). In `turret.gd` I changed `export` to `@export`, `onready` to `@onready`, `instance()` to `instantiate()`, and the signal connect and emit to the new style. The turret now adds the bullet to the tree before setting its `global_position` and `global_rotation`, so shots start at the turret and fly in the direction it faces. In `bullet.gd` I changed `export` to `@export`.
